title: Verbose route normalization + legacy field prohibition cross-check
summary: Normalize route field on m9-11..m9-18 from verbose 'B-direct (T0 + light-verify)' to bare 'B-direct'. Add cross-check #14 prohibiting legacy schema-v1 fields (change, artifacts, commits_since_base, findings_closed, etc.) on m9-19+ cycles. Pre-m9-11 cycles are exempt since their legacy data is preserved.
